goal: Prevent node event loops on POSIX platforms from spinning in busy loops when peers send TCP urgent data
Keep connection failure detection working on Windows without stalling the network thread
agreement: Suggested extending the same socket exception logic to the HTTP server (pinheadmz)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because incoming TCP urgent data can leave socket exceptions pending on POSIX systems
Fixing this avoids a potential denial of service from the P2P event loop spinning continuously
